_note: 2D green-screen teachers (PRO matte, anchor/green/kfull_pro + kmask_pro) pre-composed onto a whiteboard background = the 'green2d' set clips of the v14 board engine (scripts/video/tpl/green_set.py, docs/VIDEO-SERIES.md 'Green 2D'). One family = one teacher + one outfit + one background; the first clip is the parent, the others are its chained children (same framing). Host is never upscaled (Ama 0.8 = equal head size with Carlos 1.0), one fixed transform per teacher (eye column + head_top..neck centred at y 1080, v14 framing k = 1.0) so every clip of a family has identical framing. The board is fitted from the background (largest white component) to x 56 / y 300 so the watermark sits on the wall above it. Moods follow render_v9 line_mood; listen = closed-mouth clip for silent beats.
